# Rust boolean source

This pinned engine supplies the machine's manifold boolean operations.
[UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json) identifies the published package, source revision
and local patches. The intersection helpers inline into their callers under the
standard floating-point rules. Construction trees retain references to unchanged
meshes, and exact splits assemble both sides from one intersection search.

The engine boundary fingerprints the compiled source for geometry caches.
Keep the upstream license with these sources.
